headline: Indian Markets Begin Samvat 2083 With Special Diwali Muhurat Trading Session

marketStatus.message: Today is Diwali Laxmi Pujan. NSE will conduct Muhurat Trading. Exact trading timings are notified separately by NSE.

why: Dalal Street marks the beginning of Samvat 2083 with the traditional Diwali Muhurat Trading session.
Nifty crossed the 25,100 level early in the session driven by buying interest in headline stocks.
Finolex Cables recorded a 17% rally as Samvat 2083 trading commenced.
Indian equities recently logged their best weekly performance in six years, defying global tech routs.
whatHappening: NSE and BSE conduct the special Muhurat Trading session on the occasion of Laxmi Pujan.
Sensex surged over 300 to 400 points early in the session before witnessing volatile movements.
Sun Pharma and Tata Steel headlined the list of top gainers during the session.
Upcoming IPO lock-in expiries from Nov 9-13 bring focus to companies like LEAP India and Technocraft Ventures.
summary: Dalal Street marked the start of Samvat 2083 with the traditional Diwali Muhurat Trading session on Laxmi Pujan. Sensex and Nifty saw initial buying cheer with Nifty crossing 25,100, led by gains in Sun Pharma, Tata Steel, and Finolex Cables. The market sentiment continues to draw strength from Indian stocks posting their best weekly performance in six years.
